versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: צַ֞ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־אַתֶּ֥ם בָּאִ֖ים אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפֹּ֤ל לָכֶם֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
controles.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
controles.livre: Manda aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra de Canaã, a saber, a terra que vos há de cair em herança, a terra de Canaã segundo seus termos;

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֨ה לָכֶ֧ם פְּאַת־נֶ֛גֶב מִמִּדְבַּר־צִ֖ן עַל־יְדֵ֣י אֱד֑וֹם וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֥ה יָם־הַמֶּ֖לַח קֵֽדְמָה׃

controles.web: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
controles.kjv: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
controles.livre: Tereis o lado do sul desde o deserto de Zim até os termos de Edom; e vos será o termo do sul ao extremo do mar salgado até o oriente:

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֣ב לָכֶם֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה והיה תּֽוֹצְאֹתָ֔יו מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְיָצָ֥א חֲצַר־אַדָּ֖ר וְעָבַ֥ר עַצְמֹֽנָה׃

controles.web: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
controles.kjv: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh–barnea, and shall go on to Hazar–addar, and pass on to Azmon:
controles.livre: E este termo vos irá rodeando desde o sul até a subida de Acrabim, e passará até Zim; e suas saídas serão do sul a Cades-Barneia; e sairá a Hazar-Adar, e passará até Azmom;

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מֵעַצְמ֖וֹן נַ֣חְלָה מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּֽמָּה׃

controles.web: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
controles.kjv: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
controles.livre: E rodeará este termo, desde Azmom até o ribeiro do Egito, e seus limites serão ao ocidente.

versos.hebraico: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל יָֽם׃

controles.web: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
controles.kjv: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
controles.livre: E o termo ocidental vos será o grande mar: este termo vos será o termo ocidental.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֣וּל צָפ֑וֹן מִן־הַיָּם֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל תְּתָא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃

controles.web: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
controles.kjv: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
controles.livre: E o termo do norte será este: desde o grande mar vos assinalareis o monte de Hor;

versos.hebraico: מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר תְּתָא֖וּ לְבֹ֣א חֲמָ֑ת וְהָי֛וּ תּוֹצְאֹ֥ת הַגְּבֻ֖ל צְדָֽדָה׃

controles.web: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
controles.kjv: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
controles.livre: Do monte de Hor assinalareis à entrada de Hamate, e serão as saídas daquele termo a Zedade;

versos.hebraico: וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבֻל֙ זִפְרֹ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָ֑ן זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל צָפֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
controles.kjv: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar–enan: this shall be your north border.
controles.livre: E sairá este termo a Zifrom, e serão seus limites em Hazar-Enã: este vos será o termo do norte.

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֖ם לִגְב֣וּל קֵ֑דְמָה מֵחֲצַ֥ר עֵינָ֖ן שְׁפָֽמָה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
controles.kjv: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar–enan to Shepham:
controles.livre: E por termo ao oriente vos assinalareis desde Hazar-Enã até Sefã;

versos.hebraico: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּבֻ֧ל מִשְּׁפָ֛ם הָרִבְלָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם לָעָ֑יִן וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּב֔וּל וּמָחָ֛ה עַל־כֶּ֥תֶף יָם־כִּנֶּ֖רֶת קֵֽדְמָה׃

controles.web: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
controles.kjv: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
controles.livre: E baixará este termo desde Sefã a Ribla, ao oriente de Aim: e descerá o termo, e chegará à costa do mar de Quinerete ao oriente;

versos.hebraico: וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח זֹאת֩ תִּהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶ֖יהָ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
controles.kjv: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
controles.livre: Depois descerá este termo ao Jordão, e serão suas saídas ao mar Salgado: esta será vossa terra: por seus termos ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ בְּגוֹרָ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֛ת לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
controles.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
controles.livre: E mandou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a terra que herdareis por sorte, a qual mandou o SENHOR que desse às nove tribos, e à meia tribo:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָראוּבֵנִי֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם וּמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־הַגָּדִ֖י לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם וַחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃

controles.web: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance.
controles.kjv: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
controles.livre: Porque a tribo dos filhos de Rúben segundo as casas de seus pais, e a tribo dos filhos de Gade segundo as casas de seus pais, e a meia tribo de Manassés, tomaram sua herança:

versos.hebraico: שְׁנֵ֥י הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֑ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָֽחָה׃פ

controles.web: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
controles.kjv: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
controles.livre: Duas tribos e meia tomaram sua herança desta parte do Jordão de Jericó ao oriente, ao oriente.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יִנְחֲל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃

controles.web: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.kjv: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.livre: Estes são os nomes dos homens que vos possuirão a terra: Eleazar o sacerdote, e Josué filho de Num.

versos.hebraico: וְנָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֛ד נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֖ד מִמַּטֶּ֑ה תִּקְח֖וּ לִנְחֹ֥ל אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
controles.kjv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
controles.livre: Tomareis também de cada tribo um príncipe, para dar a possessão da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּֽה׃

controles.web: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
controles.kjv: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes dos homens: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe filho de Jefoné.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
controles.kjv: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, Samuel filho de Amiúde.

versos.hebraico: לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֱלִידָ֖ד בֶּן־כִּסְלֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
controles.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
controles.livre: Da tribo de Benjamim; Elidade filho de Quislom.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־דָ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא בֻּקִּ֖י בֶּן־יָגְלִֽי׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
controles.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Dã, o príncipe Buqui filho de Jogli.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה נָשִׂ֑יא חַנִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־אֵפֹֽד׃

controles.web: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
controles.kjv: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de José: da tribo dos filhos de Manassés, o príncipe Haniel filho de Éfode.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם נָשִׂ֑יא קְמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־שִׁפְטָֽן׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
controles.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Efraim, o príncipe Quemuel filho de Siftã.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־זְבוּלֻ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא אֱלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־פַּרְנָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
controles.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Zebulom, o príncipe Elizafã filho de Parnaque.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־יִשָׂשכָ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא פַּלְטִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַזָּֽן׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
controles.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, o príncipe Paltiel filho de Azã.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא אֲחִיה֖וּד בֶּן־שְׁלֹמִֽי׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
controles.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Aser, o príncipe Aiúde filho de Selomi.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־נַפְתָּלִ֖י נָשִׂ֑יא פְּדַהְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃

controles.web: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
controles.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, o príncipe Pedael filho de Amiúde.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה לְנַחֵ֥ל אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃פ

controles.web: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
controles.kjv: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
controles.livre: Estes são aos que mandou o SENHOR que fizessem a partição da herança aos filhos de Israel na terra de Canaã.
